messages.context: Blacksmith 新手流程实测台词（第 1 条）
messages.raw: §fReforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for Coal §8x10§f.
messages.text: Reforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for Coal x10.
messages.zh: 重铸通常要花费硬币,不过我今天心情不错,首次重铸只收煤炭 x10。

segments.text: Reforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for Coal
segments.zh: 重铸通常要花费硬币,不过我今天心情不错,首次重铸只收煤炭

messages.context: Blacksmith 新手流程实测台词（第 2 条）
messages.raw: §fGo into the Mine to collect Coal, then come back to learn how to reforge items!
messages.text: Go into the Mine to collect Coal, then come back to learn how to reforge items!
messages.zh: 去矿洞收集煤炭,然后回来学习如何重铸物品!

messages.context: Blacksmith 新手流程实测台词（第 3 条）
messages.raw: §fHowever, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of Coal §8x10§f!
messages.text: However, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of Coal x10!
messages.zh: 不过这次,任何物品我都只收煤炭 x10!
